marketRegime.rationale: US-Iran strikes resume after four-week pause; oil prices jump; geopolitical risk premium reasserts while macro data shows mixed signals across regions.

executivePulse.title: US-Iran Escalation
executivePulse.text: First direct US strike on Iran in four weeks kills two, prompts oil price surge and rate-hike speculation. Strait of Hormuz mining claims add shipping risk. Capital markets repricing geopolitical premium.

executivePulse.title: India Growth Resilience
executivePulse.text: Q1 FY27 GDP expands 7.8% YoY, beating forecasts; World Bank upgrades full-year forecast to 6.6% from 6.3%. Investment surge offsets Middle East oil headwinds, supporting EM allocation case.

executivePulse.title: Brazil Macro Stress
executivePulse.text: Growth set to slow amid high debt service (per Valor International); tariff impacts bite. Contrasts with India's momentum, signalling divergent EM trajectories for capital deployment.

houseView.label: Spain & Madrid Real Estate
houseView.change: British purchase volume slumped citing 90-day rule friction. Political scrutiny on executive acquisitions (Ayuso penthouse Court of Accounts probe) adds uncertainty. Macro backdrop remains constraining.

houseView.label: European Credit & Financing
houseView.change: No new European credit data in headline set; geopolitical premium inflates funding costs. Germany FDI rose 50% YoY in 2025 per IW, but energy cost pass-through and rate guidance remain opaque.

houseView.label: Private Capital Deployment
houseView.change: PE software repricing drives negative Q1 2026 buyout returns (HarbourVest benchmark). Midstream ($4.4bn ONEOK deal) and biotech ($2.88bn Eli Lilly–Merida) remain active; agribusiness underserved per Granite Creek commentary.

houseView.label: Energy & Commodities
houseView.change: US-Iran strikes trigger oil price surge; Asia diesel imports to Africa hit five-year highs as Middle East exports crash to nine-year lows. Lithium miners report strong H1 2026 profits on battery storage demand surge.

houseView.label: Emerging Markets
houseView.change: India FY27 Q1 GDP +7.8% beats consensus; investment surges; World Bank upgrades full-year to 6.6%. Brazil growth decelerating under debt-rate pressure; tariff headwinds documented. Divergence within EM widening.

houseView.label: Global Risk Appetite
houseView.change: US-Iran military exchange reignites geopolitical premium; rate-hike speculation resurfaces on oil prices. Ferry capsizing in Cyprus, Swiss shooting, and ongoing Strait of Hormuz threats compound near-term sentiment headwinds.

catalysts.title: Turkey August CPI Print (Economists expect 31.52% annual)

globalBriefing: US-Iran military strikes resume after four-week pause, reigniting Strait of Hormuz supply risk and triggering oil price surge; capital markets reprice geopolitical premium and rate-hike speculation despite divergent macro signals. India's 7.8% Q1 FY27 GDP beat with investment acceleration and World Bank upgrade to 6.6% full-year contrasts sharply with Brazil deceleration under debt-rate pressure and tariff headwinds, bifurcating EM capital flows toward South Asia. Energy logistics realignment (Asian diesel to Africa, LNG demand destruction in China) and lithium battery-storage strength sustain commodity capital deployment, while software M&A repricing compresses PE buyout returns and constrains dealmaker appetite outside biotech, midstream, and agribusiness niches.
marketOpen: Monitor oil price stability and equity index futures: if Brent remains above $82/bbl and geopolitical premium widens, rate-hike expectations will pressure European credit spreads and EM FX; India strength may partially offset LatAm weakness.

macro.label: Macro & Central Banks
macro.description: Central bank decisions, inflation prints, GDP, yield curves, and FX

items.headline: India Q1 FY27 GDP expands 7.8% YoY, beating forecasts; World Bank upgrades full-year growth to 6.6% from 6.3%
items.summary: India's April–June 2026 GDP growth of 7.8% per Reuters and CNBC exceeded consensus; investment surges offset Middle East energy shocks. World Bank upgrade signals sustained momentum despite commodity headwinds.
items.source: Reuters, CNBC, World Bank (News On AIR)
items.relevance: Supports EM capital allocation; India as oil-shock resilience hedge; FDI inflow narrative intact.

items.headline: Turkey Q2 GDP growth of 2.3% misses forecasts; inflation expected to ease to 31.52% in August
items.summary: Turkey's Q2 2026 expansion of 2.3% per CryptoRank fell short of expectations, signalling economic deceleration. August inflation forecast of 31.52% annually (Anadolu Agency) reflects disinflation but remains elevated.
items.relevance: EM FX and credit stress indicator; capital outflow risk if real rates compress further.

items.headline: Brazil growth set to slow as debt and high rates take toll; tariff impacts bite regional exporters
items.summary: Valor International reports Brazil's GDP expansion will decelerate amid elevated debt servicing and policy rates. Midwestern regions report tariff-driven income losses (WSJ), compressing domestic demand.
items.relevance: LatAm positioning headwind; currency and credit spread widening likely.

items.headline: Canada GDP rebound will not trigger BoC rate cut at Wednesday decision
items.summary: Wealth Professional reports second-quarter rebound insufficient to persuade Bank of Canada to cut rates at scheduled 4 September decision, signalling sticky policy stance.
items.relevance: CAD and North American fixed-income positioning; cross-border capital flow implication for private markets.

items.headline: Russian economic boom forecast to end; IMF/World Bank projects GDP growth to plummet through 2032
items.summary: The New Voice of Ukraine reports consensus expectations for Russian GDP deceleration from 2026 onwards. Sanctions, geopolitical isolation, and demographic headwinds cited as drivers.
items.source: The New Voice of Ukraine (IMF/World Bank forecast consensus)
items.relevance: EM emerging markets thesis; capital flight trajectory; commodity export pricing pressure.

macro.keyTakeaway: If India sustains 7.8%+ growth and Brazil decelerates, EM capital flows polarize toward South Asia; geopolitical premium on rates limits BoC and Turkey easing scope through Q4 2026.

geopolitics.label: Geopolitics & Security
geopolitics.description: Conflicts, alliances, sanctions, and power shifts

items.headline: US and Iran trade strikes for first time in weeks; US strike on Larak Island in Strait of Hormuz kills two, injures two
items.summary: BBC World reports first direct US military strike on Iran since late July, targeting Larak Island in Strait of Hormuz. Casualties reported; escalation cycle resumes after four-week pause.
items.relevance: Oil price volatility, shipping risk premium, capital-markets rate-hike speculation, energy financing cost impact.

items.headline: Iran claims supertanker hit by naval mines in Strait of Hormuz; US alleges Iran mining capability
items.summary: OilPrice.com reports Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps statement on supertanker fire caused by mine strikes in southern Strait of Hormuz. Al Jazeera analysis notes US claims of Iranian rocket-mining capability face feasibility skepticism from analysts.
items.relevance: Shipping insurance, energy logistics, LNG pricing, global supply-chain routing risk.

items.headline: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Turkey defence pact tested as US-Iran strikes resume
items.summary: Al Jazeera reports trilateral defence mechanism under stress; third-party membership expansion and pact credibility at question mark amid renewed US-Iran military exchange.
items.relevance: Regional geopolitical realignment; sovereign risk for Saudi/UAE capital markets; defence spending allocation signals.

items.headline: Airlines and automakers hit by Iran conflict; banks and energy firms post big profits
items.summary: Al Jazeera analysis documents asymmetric sectoral impact: aviation and automotive suffer supply-chain disruption; financials and energy benefit from margin widening and hedging activity.
items.relevance: Sector rotation implications; equity and credit allocation tilts; M&A and restructuring opportunity set.

geopolitics.keyTakeaway: If US-Iran strikes continue, Strait of Hormuz logistics costs and energy volatility premium persist; financial services and commodities outperformance likely, dragging transport/auto valuations.

fdi.label: FDI & Capital Flows
fdi.description: Cross-border investments, sovereign wealth, and capital movements

items.headline: Foreign investment in Germany rose 50% in 2025, IW reports
items.summary: Reuters Capital reports Institut der deutschen Wirtschaft data showing year-on-year 50% rise in inbound FDI to Germany in 2025, signalling continued Western Europe capital attraction despite macro headwinds.
items.relevance: European private capital deployment thesis; Germany as strategic capital hub vs. Southern Europe; real estate and infrastructure focus areas.

items.headline: India smashes growth forecasts; investment surges in April-June Q1 FY27
items.summary: Reuters reports capital formation acceleration driving India's 7.8% Q1 GDP beat. Domestic and foreign investment flows strengthening alongside consumption, per CNBC and WSJ coverage.
items.relevance: Institutional FDI thesis validation; India as preferred EM destination; infrastructure and manufacturing capex cycle entry signal.

items.headline: Ukraine's former defence chief seeks US investment for defence tech fund, FT reports
items.summary: Reuters Capital reports Ukraine defence sector capital-raising effort targeting US institutional backing for tech-focused fund amid ongoing security tensions.
items.relevance: Defence-tech private capital opportunity; geopolitical risk hedging; Eastern European strategic asset class.

items.headline: Nigeria retains $53bn external reserves; deployment for insecurity response questioned
items.summary: TheCable reports debate over Nigeria's reserve drawdown capacity and willingness to deploy capital for domestic security spending, signalling sovereign capital allocation constraints.
items.relevance: EM sovereign wealth and infrastructure capex thesis; Nigeria credit spread implications; African FDI destination risk.

fdi.keyTakeaway: If India sustains investment-led growth and Germany maintains 50% YoY FDI momentum, Northern Europe and South Asia displace Southern Europe as institutional capital flow vectors through 2026.

critical-minerals.label: Commodities & Energy
critical-minerals.description: Oil, gas, metals, supply chains, and energy security

items.headline: US and Iran exchange fire; oil prices surge higher as Middle East export disruption spreads
items.summary: Yahoo Finance, The Hill, New York Times all report global oil price jump following renewed US-Iran strikes. Supply disruption from Middle East refinery outages and shipping threats documented.
items.source: Yahoo Finance, The Hill, NYT, OilPrice.com
items.relevance: Energy cost inflation across all sectors; shipping and logistics margin expansion; capital-intensive project financing repricing.

items.headline: Asia diesel exports to Africa surge to near five-year highs as Middle East sales crash to nine-year lows
items.summary: OilPrice.com (Reuters analysis) documents Asian refineries filling vacuum as Middle East exports to Africa collapse. Logistics route diversification and pricing arbitrage drivers.
items.relevance: Energy supply-chain realignment; shipping cost arbitrage; African energy infrastructure capital needs.

items.headline: China's LNG imports set to drop 18% in August YoY as prices soar; demand destruction evident
items.summary: OilPrice.com reports Bloomberg data: Chinese LNG volumes slump 18% YoY in August amid elevated pricing, reversing three-month summer rebound trend. Price elasticity and demand destruction signals documented.
items.relevance: Global LNG supply glut thesis challenged; price inflation sustainability question; Asia energy cost pass-through.

items.headline: Lithium miners report strong H1 2026 profits as battery storage demand surges; production ramp-ups planned
items.summary: Mining.com reports lithium sector H1 2026 earnings strength driven by battery storage capacity demand acceleration. Miners announcing production expansion capex.
items.relevance: Energy transition capex cycle acceleration; critical minerals capital deployment; long-duration commodity thesis.

items.headline: Trump administration secures 25-year oil pact granting US access to Venezuelan reserves; legal and transparency concerns raised
items.summary: ABC7 Bay Area and OilPrice.com report US-Venezuela oil deal framework. Mining.com notes expert concerns on legal standing, contract duration, and development execution risks.
items.relevance: Western Hemisphere energy supply security; geopolitical capital flows; long-duration commodity contract execution risk.

critical-minerals.keyTakeaway: If Strait of Hormuz logistics costs persist and China LNG demand destruction holds, Asian energy inflation sustains; lithium and battery storage remains structural tailwind for renewables capex.

real-estate.label: Real Estate & Infrastructure
real-estate.description: Institutional RE, infrastructure projects, and market trends

items.headline: British home purchases in Spain slump; 90-day rule compliance friction blamed
items.summary: Majorca Daily Bulletin reports sharp decline in UK buyer volumes in Spanish property market, attributed to post-Brexit 90-day visa rule restrictions on transaction cycles.
items.relevance: Madrid/coastal real estate demand headwind; foreign capital flows to Spain constrained; cross-border private client allocation friction.

items.headline: Court of Accounts asked to investigate Madrid regional President Ayuso's penthouse acquisition
items.summary: El Constitucional reports Más Madrid party formal request to Court of Accounts to probe property purchase terms and transparency. Political scrutiny on executive real estate dealings.
items.relevance: Madrid executive real estate market transparency concern; political risk discount on high-net-worth residential; institutional investor confidence friction.

items.headline: Newmark Group Q2 2026 real estate sector recovery and growth underpin bull case
items.summary: Seeking Alpha reports Newmark institutional view: US real estate sector showing recovery momentum supported by Q2 data, backing structural growth thesis for REITs and private real estate capital.
items.relevance: North American real estate capital deployment optionality; REIT and CRE financing cost trajectory.

items.headline: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners acquires onshore wind and battery project in Australia; Chile green ammonia project unanimously approved
items.summary: Yahoo Finance reports CIP transaction in Australian renewables; energynews.pro reports Chilean Magallanes region unanimous approval of HNH Energy green ammonia capex.
items.relevance: Infrastructure-linked real assets and energy transition capex; cross-border private capital flow to green energy; long-duration inflation-hedged returns.

real-estate.keyTakeaway: If British purchase friction persists and political transparency scrutiny on Madrid high-net-worth deals tightens, European coastal residential real estate faces headwinds; infrastructure-linked green projects attract institutional capital.

ma-growth.label: M&A & Private Capital
ma-growth.description: Deal flow, PE/VC activity, and corporate transactions

items.headline: HarbourVest Private Equity Benchmarks: Software repricing drives negative Q1 2026 buyout returns
items.summary: Business Wire reports HarbourVest fund benchmark data: Q1 2026 buyout performance turned negative, driven by software sector asset repricing and valuation compression.
items.relevance: PE deployment headwind; software sector M&A valuation environment deteriorated; capital call pacing pressure on LPs.

items.headline: Eli Lilly completes $2.88bn Merida Therapeutics buyout for autoimmune drug pipeline
items.summary: Fierce Biotech reports pharma M&A: Eli Lilly acquisition of Merida targeting rogue antibody-related autoimmune disorders. Strategic tuck-in for immunology platform.
items.relevance: Biotech M&A appetite sustained; immunology sector strategic capex; private biotech exit window.

items.headline: Old Ironsides and EnCap Flatrock agree Brazos Midstream sale to ONEOK for $4.4bn
items.summary: PE Hub reports midstream asset sale: Brazos Midstream (largest privately held Midland Basin platform) sold to ONEOK with capacity expansion (1.2 Bcf/d by 2027 via Cassidy II project).
items.relevance: Energy midstream PE exit; infrastructure capex commitment; commodity hedging and fee-stable cash flow capture.

items.headline: Authentic Brands Group (backed by CVC, General Atlantic) acquires OVO; Granite Creek Capital focuses on agribusiness platform M&A
items.summary: PE Hub reports Authentic Brands deal (CVC/GA-backed) in lifestyle IP. Granite Creek commentary highlights agribusiness platform underserved by institutional capital, especially lower-middle market.
items.relevance: Consumer/brand IP and agribusiness sector private capital deployment; niche PE thesis execution.

items.headline: Sentinel Capital Partners sells Revenew International to Bernhard Capital Partners
items.summary: PE Hub reports secondary transaction: specialty cost-recovery professional services firm exits to Bernhard. Portfolio company helped clients generate $2bn+ in hard-dollar savings.
items.relevance: PE secondary and exit market; services-sector M&A optionality.

ma-growth.keyTakeaway: If software repricing persists, Q1 2026 negative buyout returns compress deployment appetite; energy (midstream), biotech, and agribusiness remain defensible pockets for institutional PE capital.

emerging-markets.label: Emerging Markets
emerging-markets.description: Frontier opportunities, risk signals, and market access

items.headline: India Q1 FY27 GDP 7.8% YoY, beating forecasts; investment surge offsets Middle East oil shocks; World Bank upgrades full-year to 6.6%
items.summary: Reuters, CNBC, WSJ, Bloomberg all confirm India's 7.8% April–June 2026 expansion, driven by capex cycle acceleration. World Bank raises FY27 forecast to 6.6% from 6.3%, signalling sustained momentum despite commodity headwinds.
items.source: Reuters, CNBC, WSJ, Bloomberg, World Bank
items.relevance: EM capital allocation thesis; India as oil-shock resilience play; FDI inflow sustenance; sector rotation within Asia.

items.headline: Brazil growth set to slow as debt, high rates take toll; tariff impacts documented in Midwest stronghold
items.summary: Valor International reports deceleration outlook for Brazil under elevated debt servicing and monetary tightness. WSJ details tariff-driven income losses in right-wing farming regions, compressing domestic demand.
items.relevance: LatAm divergence from EM consensus; Brazil currency depreciation risk; credit spread widening pressure.

items.headline: BYD announces up to 500 million reais investment in Brazil energy storage strategy expansion
items.summary: BNamericas reports Chinese EV/battery giant BYD capex commitment to Brazil energy storage sector, advancing regional energy transition infrastructure.
items.relevance: Brazil infrastructure capex inflow; China–Brazil capital flows; energy transition financing channels.

items.headline: Russia economic boom forecast to end; IMF/World Bank project GDP growth plummet through 2032
items.summary: The New Voice of Ukraine reports consensus EM forecaster outlook: Russian GDP deceleration from 2026 onwards driven by sanctions, geopolitical isolation, and demographic headwinds.
items.relevance: EM capital flight trajectory; commodity export pricing pressure; geopolitical risk capital flows.

emerging-markets.keyTakeaway: India bull case intact on investment surge and World Bank upgrade; Brazil deceleration and tariff headwinds widen EM divergence, shifting capital flows from LatAm to South Asia through 2026.

trade-policy.label: Trade & Industrial Policy
trade-policy.description: Tariffs, sanctions, export controls, and economic statecraft

items.headline: Tariffs squeeze Iowa and Midwestern states; Trump tariff regime impacts regional agriculture and manufacturing
items.summary: Des Moines Register reports regional economic pressure study documenting tariff impact across Midwest. ABC News reports Trump beef plan and tariffs risk GOP voter alienation in farm belt.
items.relevance: US domestic political economy feedback on trade policy; agricultural input cost inflation; regional capex retrenchment.

items.headline: Brazil right-wing stronghold hammered by Trump tariffs; regional economic hardship documented
items.summary: WSJ reports tariff-driven income losses concentrating in Brazilian Midwest farming regions, creating electoral/political pressure against protectionist trade regime.
items.relevance: LatAm currency depreciation and credit spread widening; political economy of trade friction.

items.headline: Toyota and Honda may get stuck with bill for Trump Canada tariffs; automaker cost pass-through risk
items.summary: Reuters reports North American automaker exposure to Trump tariff regime targeting Canadian components. OEM capex and sourcing reconfiguration likely.
items.relevance: Auto sector margin compression; capital allocation to Mexico/nearshoring; currency hedging costs.

items.headline: Trump tariffs not reducing US trade deficit; structural imbalance persists per WaPo analysis
items.summary: Washington Post opinion reports economic analysis: Trump tariff regime has not achieved stated deficit-reduction objective, signalling policy ineffectiveness on macro flows.
items.relevance: Macro structural imbalance thesis; capital flow sustainability; FX volatility.

trade-policy.keyTakeaway: If tariff pressure persists on Midwest, Canada, and Brazil, nearshoring capex accelerates while agricultural input costs rise; US trade deficit structural, sustaining FX volatility.

food-agriculture.label: Food & Agriculture
food-agriculture.description: Food security, agribusiness, and agricultural commodities

items.headline: Global wheat prices reach three-year high as agricultural commodities surge
items.summary: Streamlinefeed reports global wheat price spike to three-year peaks amid broader ag commodity inflation. Supply tightness and geopolitical supply-chain disruption factors cited.
items.relevance: Food inflation, emerging market import bills, farmer income support policy pressure.

items.headline: US farmers face $31bn in losses as Iran war drives diesel and fertilizer costs up
items.summary: Yahoo Finance reports cumulative US farm sector losses attributed to energy cost escalation from Middle East conflict. Input cost pass-through compressing margins.
items.relevance: Agricultural input cost inflation; policy support demand; farm equipment/services sector margin compression.

items.headline: UK farmers face nearly £5bn hit after three years of poor harvests
items.summary: Nation.Cymru reports cumulative income loss to UK farming sector across three-year drought/weather cycle. Structural viability pressure.
items.relevance: EU/UK agricultural policy support requirements; agribusiness consolidation pressure.

items.headline: U.S. agriculture opens September with rising corn and pressure on beef prices; USDA research cuts raise cyclospora risk
items.summary: AgroLatam reports September 2026 crop price strength offset by beef sector pressure. Yahoo Finance and AgroLatam cite USDA research budget constraints raising food safety surveillance risks.
items.relevance: Food price inflation and volatility; public health/biosecurity risk premium.

food-agriculture.keyTakeaway: If Middle East energy costs remain elevated and weather patterns persist, global ag commodity inflation sustains; US and UK farm sector margin compression drives policy support demand and consolidation acceleration.
